fields.title: ctb.gov.vu Vanuatu tender record
fields.description: One record per tender card. Shape is identical for recordType CURRENT_TENDER (listType=current) and TENDER_RESULT (listType=results) -- only the source archive differs. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which list this record came from: 'list:current' or 'list:results'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

tenderType.title: Solicitation type
tenderType.description: e.g. 'Request For Tender', 'Request For Proposal' -- parsed from the upstream card's own label, which varies by tender.

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: The Central Tender Board's own reference code for this solicitation.

purchaser.title: Purchaser
purchaser.description: The procuring ministry, department, or project.

submissionDate.title: Submission date
submissionDate.description: Upstream free-text bid submission deadline, usually 'DD Mon YYYY HH:MM'.

expiryDate.title: Expiry date
expiryDate.description: Upstream free-text tender expiry date, usually 'DD Mon YYYY'.

description.title: Description
description.description: Full free-text description as published by CTB.

detailUrl.title: Detail page URL
detailUrl.description: The tender's own ctb.gov.vu page, with a few extra fields not repeated here (Date Issued, Completion Date, Opening date/time, Contact Person/Email).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns -- rows missing a given column render blank.
